text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her insistence, I visit the office of the

mysterious producer Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, umm... the "Grand Concert," was it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was an annual concert where
every Tracen
student got the chance to
be on stage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
One by one, they sang their feelings of
gratitude
out to their fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A concert featuring every student?! That sounds like a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want in! We're doing it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, probably because the Twinkle
Series has
grown a lot since then.
choice_data_list: But why aren't you doing it now?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
With so many more races and registered
runners,
there just wasn't enough room
for everyone in the
Grand Concert
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It started out as something the
Umamusume put
on themselves. But as
the event grew bigger,
preparing for it
took more time than they had to
spare.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's when the URA proposed the idea
of
winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The whole point of the Grand Concert
was to
express gratitude to fans, so
holding a concert
after every race would
be more efficient.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Plus, tying the concerts to races meant
that the
URA could manage them,
taking the burden off
the runners
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts proved to be a hit,
more than
the Grand Concert ever was.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The promise of center stage captivated
runners,
both winners and losers alike,
and—most of
all—their fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Everybody in racing was absolutely
enthralled...
so much so that they forgot
all about the Grand
Concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts now provide a dream
for all
Umamusume to chase, and have
elevated the
Twinkle Series to greater
prestige.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I can't help but feel that it's
led some
runners to lose sight of the
concerts' original
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts are seen as a stage for
the
victors first and foremost.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But just because you don't win, just
because
you're not center stage, doesn't
mean you can't
convey gratitude to your
fans.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about you, but I don't want to
get too
used to this dance. If I can get
through it with a
smile, it means I'll never
reach center stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's why we need the Grand Concert
now more
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to give Umamusume a place
where they
can simply convey their
gratitude to their fans,
without worrying
about anything else.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Please, this would mean so much!

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Times have changed, you must

understand. I fail to see the point in a
reboot now
that winning concerts have
become the norm.

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention, a new event on the
calendar
would only put more stress on
the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we haven't received any
requests to
bring it back either...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What if I gathered support from people
who
wanted to see it again?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If voices hoping for a reboot fill the
academy
halls, will the board
reconsider?

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
...At the very least, we may give the idea
another
look.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's where things currently stand. And
so I've
called you here to ask for your
help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...You have mine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want to make this happen! I just know everyone would love a chance to give back to their fans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please! We need this concert!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if we need help from more people,
how about
we start a petition or do a
concert to get the
word out?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Like a promotion concert, almost?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, before this, I'd never even
heard of
the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So I think we should start by letting
people know
what it is—a concert for us
to give thanks to our
fans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Also, you know how when there's a
singer you
don't know at a concert, and
you're not really
invested at first, but
then you find yourself
listening along?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, that happens because
there's
power in songs.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So if we just sing our hearts out to them,
I'm sure
more people will join our cause!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes, I see...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I've gone ahead and booked a stage for
our
concert!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I couldn't get the stage
here, since
it's not a school event, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I did manage to rent the stage closest to
campus,
where there should be plenty of
foot traffic!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I've also contacted people who can take
care of
the sound and lights, so as soon
as everything's
set up, we'll be good to
go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, this is so exciting! I need to
start
rehearsing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but first I need to figure out the
other
dancers' schedules, tell the dance
instructor, and
think of a setlist...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it's starting to hit Smart
Falcon just
how much there is to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that work would definitely be a bit

overwhelming.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? Are you sure?
choice_data_list: I'll handle adjusting the schedule and stuff.
I'll handle adjusting the schedule and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, if there's anything I can help with,
just let
me know! I'll do everything I can!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Woo!
choice_data_list: Let's all do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, I now have to think about getting

<chrname> concert-ready in
addition
to her normal training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though from what I hear, there is some
overlap.
Dance and vocal lessons, for
example, often
involve building a strong
core.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Incorporating these lessons into our
schedule will
improve
<chrname>'s abilities and set

her up for success on stage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Plus, concerts themselves may be good

opportunities for <chrname>
to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a brief chat, we decide to hold our
first
concert in late December.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we can make it a success, it'll be a big
first step
on our way to the Grand
Concert!
